issue.title: A component with a nested `Inspectable` field causes a panic when expanded

repository.name: bevy_editor_pls
repository.description: In-App editor tools for bevy applications

issue.body:
```
#[derive(Component, Inspectable, Debug)]
pub struct Behavior {
    actor: Entity,
    state: BehaviorState,
}

#[derive(Inspectable, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
pub enum BehaviorState {
    Inactive,
    Running,
    Succeeded,
    Failed,
}
```

repository.name: bevy
repository.description: A refreshingly simple data-driven game engine built in Rust

issue.body:
# Objective

- Fixes #5365 
- The `assert!()` when the resource from `World::resource_scope` is inserted into the world is not descriptive.

## Solution

- Add more context to the assert inside of `World::resource_scope` when the `FnOnce` param inserts the resource.
